formats.key: Permit(address owner,address spender,uint256 value,uint256 nonce,uint256 deadline)
effects: Sets the allowance of `spender` over the owner's amWETH (Aave Polygon aToken) to exactly `value`. This replaces any earlier allowance; it does not add to it.
Uses up the owner's current permit nonce, so any other signed permit with the same nonce stops working.
Anyone can submit the signature until `deadline`. Once submitted, the allowance has no end date. No tokens move when the permit is signed or submitted.
formats.shown: Authorize spending of tokens: Spender (raw address), Max spending amount in amWETH (or 'Unlimited' at 2^255 and above), Valid until (date), Owner; the nonce is hidden.

findings.title: Permit has no interpolatedIntent, so the intent line names neither the amount nor the spender.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json display.formats Permit: "intent": "Authorize spending of tokens", interpolatedIntent absent; AToken.sol permit(): _approve(owner, spender, value)
findings.fix: Add interpolatedIntent "Allow {spender} to spend up to {value}".
